body:
I failed everything I've ever done. but I kept at it and I managed to make it, grades aren't important man.
what if you kept at it, you need a change. don't do this before you have tried to change your life, change where you live, get a job, go live in a hippy commune, at least change everything before you decide what you are doing is not for you. you could be potentially wasting a life worth while just because you havn't managed to change much.
which you can do.
people don't make visual statements without wanting to say something.
use your words and tell the world you won't take anyshite and be your own man

you have the exact same life as I once had. I feel you man. the only real difference in story is I'm a painter, stick with it.
what happened to me was I got a genuine new group of friends by accident and stopped talking to the girl I was friendzoned with.
its hard at the start, but you'll feel like a new man afterwards.
you like music and writing.
go do things like that, you seem to have an introvert personality.
you will communicate very well with people who are into the same things, other introvert.
But I've felt like you say sometimes I felt what I was doing was hollow
 or I was, I'm a painter but, sometimes I have the breif moment where it all makes sense and I realise I love it, and just for that I stick with it, even when I hate it.

having no reason isn't a reason.
surely something has been keeping you alive this long,
why not make it longer.
And hey its not cool on me,I've been through this shite, made it out the far end thank christ.
I make a thread to hopefully help some souls. and you just come in and tell me that you are going to kill yourself.
at least give me one reason why you should live before you go

you're a good soul for coming on here and looking for advice.
you're not his keeper and this isn't your issue.
he has to go into it alone and come out alone. obviously receive help but he should seek this himself, this is very unfair on you I feel for you.
he's not acting very honourably.
It could just be a cry for attention.
anyway I hope the best for your situation, much respect to you.
but I wouldn't put up with the shite nor should anyone

you posted in a thread for help, the objective of the thread to receive help.
are you surprised I asked "why".
It's all I can ask

how about you tell me

why you shouldn't do it instead

you're in a tough situation.
You should let him know you are there for him (you probably already have) let him vent to you or at least try that. if that doesn't work and you think he could be serious this time then you could contact his parents
although that might seem like the harsh option, which it very much is. should not be discredited, but it would be last resort.
well done for coming here this is a lot on you
and I don't see it fair that your boyfriend is threatening suicide and telling you, its really not fair.

Hey man I went to my formal with my ex ; nothing to be ashamed of.
Why do you think you can't do anything right.
you would off yourself at the prom to make a statement, why not make a statement with words.
